mapper.select: SELECT o.OPP_ID AS "opportunityId",o.OPP_NM AS "opportunityName", o.CUST_CLNT_ID AS "customerId",c.CLNT_NM AS "customerName",o.SALES_STEP_CD AS "stageCode", o.WIN_PRBL_RT AS "winningProbability",o.EXPCT_AMT AS "expectedAmount", to_char(to_date(o.BGN_PLAN_YM,'YYYYMM'),'YYYY-MM') AS "startMonth", o.NEXT_TODO_CN AS "nextAction",o.NEXT_TODO_DDLN_DT AS "nextActionDueDate", o.APRV_STAT_CD AS "approvalStatusCode",COALESCE(o.MOD_DTTM,o.REG_DTTM) AS "modifiedAt", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(n.NEED_CNT*n.MON_MM) FROM TB_SL_OPP_NEED n WHERE n.OPP_ID=o.OPP_ID),0) AS "manpower" FROM TB_SL_OPP o JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=o.CUST_CLNT_ID WHERE o.OPP_STAT_CD='ING' ORDER BY COALESCE(o.MOD_DTTM,o.REG_DTTM) DESC,o.OPP_ID
SELECT n.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",COALESCE(c.CODE_NM,n.JOB_CD) AS "jobName" FROM TB_SL_OPP_NEED n LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND c.CODE=n.JOB_CD WHERE n.OPP_ID=#{id} ORDER BY n.NEED_SN
SELECT c.CODE AS "jobCode",c.CODE_NM AS "jobName" FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE c.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND c.DEL_YN='N' ORDER BY c.SORT_ORD,c.CODE

SELECT o.OPP_ID AS "opportunityId",o.OPP_NM AS "opportunityName",c.CLNT_NM AS "customerName", o.OPP_STAT_CD AS "result",o.EXPCT_AMT AS "expectedAmount",o.RSLT_DT AS "resultDate", CASE WHEN o.OPP_STAT_CD='WIN' THEN o.PROJ_ID END AS "projectId", CASE WHEN o.OPP_STAT_CD='LOSE' THEN concat_ws(' · ',r.CODE_NM,o.LOSE_MEMO) END AS "lossReason" FROM TB_SL_OPP o JOIN TB_BS_CLNT c ON c.CLNT_ID=o.CUST_CLNT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE r ON r.CODE_GRP_ID='LOSE_RSN' AND r.CODE=o.LOSE_RSN_CD WHERE o.OPP_STAT_CD IN ('WIN','LOSE','STOP') AND o.OPP_STAT_CD=#{result} ORDER BY o.RSLT_DT DESC,o.OPP_ID

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.APLY_UPRC*m.MON_MM) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=m.PROJ_ID WHERE m.INPUT_YM=#{month} AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' AND a.INPUT_TYPE_CD!='FREE' AND p.PROJ_STAT_CD='ING' AND p.CTRT_TYPE_CD IN ('MO','DP') AND a.INPUT_BGN_DT <= #{lastDay} AND a.INPUT_END_DT >= #{firstDay}),0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(GREATEST(0,p.CTRT_AMT-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(b.SPLY_AMT) FROM TB_BL_BILL b WHERE b.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID AND b.CNCL_YN='N'),0)) / NULLIF((extract(year FROM p.CTRT_END_DT)::int-extract(year FROM CAST(#{horizonStart} AS date))::int)*12 +extract(month FROM p.CTRT_END_DT)::int-extract(month FROM CAST(#{horizonStart} AS date))::int+1,0)) FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p WHERE p.PROJ_STAT_CD='ING' AND p.CTRT_TYPE_CD='TK' AND p.CTRT_END_DT >= #{firstDay} AND p.CTRT_BGN_DT <= #{lastDay}),0) AS "projectRevenue", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.EXPCT_AMT/COALESCE(o.EXPCT_PRD_MCNT,6)*o.WIN_PRBL_RT/100) FROM TB_SL_OPP o WHERE o.OPP_STAT_CD='ING' AND to_date(o.BGN_PLAN_YM,'YYYYMM') <= #{firstDay} AND to_date(o.BGN_PLAN_YM,'YYYYMM')+make_interval(months => COALESCE(o.EXPCT_PRD_MCNT,6)::int) > #{firstDay}),0) AS "weightedOpportunityRevenue", COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.EXPCT_AMT/COALESCE(o.EXPCT_PRD_MCNT,6)) FROM TB_SL_OPP o WHERE o.OPP_STAT_CD='ING' AND to_date(o.BGN_PLAN_YM,'YYYYMM') <= #{firstDay} AND to_date(o.BGN_PLAN_YM,'YYYYMM')+make_interval(months => COALESCE(o.EXPCT_PRD_MCNT,6)::int) > #{firstDay}),0) AS "opportunityRevenue"

SELECT n.PLAN_MM AS "plannedMm",COALESCE((SELECT SUM(m.MON_MM) FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_MON m JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN a ON a.ASGN_ID=m.ASGN_ID AND a.ASGN_STAT_CD='ACT' WHERE m.PROJ_ID=n.PROJ_ID AND a.JOB_CD=n.JOB_CD),0) AS "confirmedMm", ((extract(year FROM p.CTRT_END_DT)::int-extract(year FROM CAST(#{horizonStart} AS date))::int)*12 +extract(month FROM p.CTRT_END_DT)::int-extract(month FROM CAST(#{horizonStart} AS date))::int+1) AS "remainingMonths" FROM TB_PJ_MNPW_PLAN n JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=n.PROJ_ID WHERE n.JOB_CD=#{jobCode} AND p.PROJ_STAT_CD='ING' AND p.CTRT_TYPE_CD!='IN' AND p.CTRT_BGN_DT <= #{lastDay} AND p.CTRT_END_DT >= #{firstDay} ORDER BY n.PROJ_ID,n.JOB_CD
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM TB_HR_CAND c WHERE c.JOB_CD=#{jobCode} AND c.CNTC_STAT_CD NOT IN ('HOLD','CTRT')
